name: sol8-media-status
goal: Show correct diagnostic counts and empty messages, visible image load/error status, and disabled comparison feedback.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Current-code API captures reproduce 1 entries, blank diagnostic attempts, image states without status, and identical disabled/enabled comparison cards.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The catalog checked role wiring and disabled flags but not visible diagnostic grammar, empty messages, image status text or disabled paint. Extend the same post-capture assertions.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: Record f0b3a10ade2a3b702a7af63a23dccc96be6c2340352aaa98c43d16d38b583af8 at d0fa389701 fails all 15 frozen viewport cases on visible diagnostics, image status and disabled paint.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Repairs 46ce75f306 and e19ba569fa correct diagnostic grammar and empty attempts, announce image loading/failure, and paint disabled comparisons in the shared stylesheet.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: Unchanged 15-case command passes at e19ba569fa; record 75b47f9829a55b7b9bdf7de2cf060d712f84b755033c2ed51d4d9b79ce1b55b4. Red f0b3a10ade2 fails the same five states at every viewport.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
